The marriages of popular content creators Jarvis and Peller; as well as singer, Sina Rambo and his estranged wife, Heidi Korth, have come under renewed scrutiny following public disputes and allegations of serious disagreements. While a viral livestream captured Jarvis and Peller trading words over the involvement of the latter in her younger sister’s affairs, leaked chats and audio recordings involving Sina Rambo and Korth have reignited controversy over their troubled relationship. In a video that circulated on X on October 23, Jarvis and Peller engaged in a heated argument over her younger sister’s emerging streaming career, with both parties expressing opposing views on family involvement and personal boundaries. During the exchange, Peller reportedly maintained that he and Jarvis had assumed parental roles in the younger woman’s life and should be involved in advising her, including decisions about her future. “It’s me that will tell her what to do,” he said. Jarvis, however, disagreed with his position, questioning why he was involving himself in her family’s affairs. “What concern you and my sister? Leave her alone,” she retorted, urging him to concentrate on his own family. The disagreement reportedly escalated when Peller removed Jarvis from the livestream and blocked members of her family on social media. Jarvis subsequently blocked her husband, who later reportedly took to his WhatsApp channel to insult her before blocking her in return. The latest fallout has drawn attention to earlier disagreements between the couple, who has been at the centre of public discussions about their relationship in recent months. My husband is not responsible for my family. God forbid, I would never let that happen,” she said. She added that she did not allow her relatives to ask her husband for financial assistance, stressing that his responsibility was to her and their baby. The development follows an earlier incident during the couple’s stay in the United Kingdom, when Jarvis was seen fighting back tears during a livestream as she accused Peller of neglecting her. She complained that he had spent time with billionaire businessman King Ochacho and his son, Iceking, without adequately checking on her. According to her, Peller called her only to hand the phone over to Iceking, without asking about her welfare. Jarvis also claimed that her attempts to reach him afterwards were unsuccessful and that she had been left to handle household chores at their UK apartment despite her condition. Meanwhile, Sina Rambo and Korth have also returned to the spotlight following fresh allegations of domestic violence, financial disagreements and irreconcilable differences. The controversy intensified after leaked chats and audio recordings involving the pair circulated online. In one of her social media posts, Korth shared a video showing herself covered in blood. She said she had never intended to make her private life public but expressed gratitude for the support she had received from friends and family since reports of their troubled marriage resurfaced. She also expressed the hope that her daughters would marry men who were kind and considerate and who would love, respect and cherish them. In the leaked exchanges, Korth accused Sina Rambo of seizing her passport and preventing her from travelling to the United States. She also alleged that he secured accommodation for her and their three children in an estate whose maintenance costs and service charges he could not afford. She further accused him of damaging her confidence and self-esteem over the years. In response, Sina Rambo reportedly accused her of refusing to comply with his instructions, asking her to either return home peacefully or leave their children with him. He also allegedly accused her of being a traitor for sharing a song by music duo P-Square on her social media page and questioned her ability to satisfy him as a woman. In other messages, he reportedly body-shamed her and described her as worthless. The latest controversy revives a dispute that first attracted widespread attention in 2022, when Korth publicly accused the singer of domestic violence and financial neglect. At the time, she shared videos, photographs and screenshots online to support her allegations, claiming that she had endured abuse during their marriage and had covered several family expenses. Sina Rambo denied the allegations through a statement issued by his legal representatives, describing the claims as baseless and insisting that he had never engaged in domestic violence. His camp maintained that their disagreements were private family matters. The dispute deepened when Korth also alleged that one of his sisters physically assaulted her, an accusation that was rejected by Sina Rambo’s camp. In 2023, Korth reportedly indicated that she wanted to sell her wedding ring and described herself as divorced. However, the pair appeared to have reconciled in 2024 and welcomed another child together, leading to speculation that they had resolved their differences. The latest allegations have once again raised questions about the state of their relationship. Neither Sina Rambo nor Korth has officially confirmed a fresh separation.
